title: Three one-use sets are not size-bounded
evidence: mcp-grants.server.ts spentCodes, spentProposals and spentWrites are not size-bounded; they are keyed by signed codes or authenticated connections. Other in-memory maps with an expiry and no size bound: supabase-guest.server.ts guestIpRateMap, lab-batches.server.ts activeBatches and undeletedBatches, api.chat.ts orderCache. app/lib/ttl-bound.test.ts names them all.
